title: She survived the zombies her files didnt

lines.tts: [tense, then dry] She survived the zombie apocalypse. Her files... did not.
lines.text: She survived the zombie apocalypse. Her files... did not.

lines.tts: Kai kept everything on one laptop. Maps. Supply lists. Every plan.
lines.text: Kai kept everything on one laptop. Maps. Supply lists. Every plan.

lines.tts: [dry] Day one of the apocalypse... and she was back to zero.
lines.text: Day one of the apocalypse... and she was back to zero.

lines.tts: [hushed, building] Then an old survivor taught her one rule: three, two, one.
lines.text: Then an old survivor taught her one rule: three, two, one.

lines.tts: [confident] Three copies of everything. On two different kinds of storage. And one kept somewhere else.
lines.text: Three copies of everything. On two different kinds of storage. And one kept somewhere else.

lines.tts: [teasing] So the next time a zombie ate her laptop...
lines.text: So the next time a zombie ate her laptop...

lines.tts: [smug, calm] Bon appetit. I have backups.
That's the three-two-one backup rule. Set it up before your apocalypse.
lines.text: That's the three-two-one backup rule. Set it up before your apocalypse.

lines.tts: [polite, hopeful] Excuse me... could I get a copy too?
lines.text: Excuse me... could I get a copy too?

lines.tts: [friendly] Comment BACKUP for the free backup checklist.
